welcomeCopy: Find reliable help or your next opportunity. One account, two ways to get started.
registerCopy: Your mobile number helps our team coordinate your work. No phone OTP is required for this release.
passwordHelp: Use at least 12 characters. You can paste from your password manager.
resetCopy: We will send a secure reset link to your email.
resetSent: If an account exists, you will receive a reset email.
resetDone: Password updated. You can now sign in.
switchLater: You can switch between hiring and finding work later.
hireCopy: Tell us the help you need. Our team will coordinate a suitable worker.
workCopy: Build your profile, get verified, and receive local work offers.
deleteExplanation: This requests account deletion and signs you out. Our team will resolve active work and retain only records required under the approved retention policy.
clientHomeCopy: Choose a service. We will help with the rest.
noRequests: No requests yet. Choose a service to tell us what you need.
workerHomeCopy: Your availability tells our team when to send you offers.
underReviewCopy: Our team will review your documents. You can check your verification progress below.
locationHelp: Location is used for service availability and shift check-in only.
availabilitySetupHelp: Choose your preferred service area. Location access is requested only when you go online or check in for a shift.
permissionDenied: Location permission is off. Enable it in Settings or ask operations for help.
noOffers: No offers yet. Keep your profile verified and availability up to date.
replacementCopy: Our team will review your request and coordinate a replacement. Your work history remains available.
reviewSaved: Thank you. Your review is saved.
earningsCopy: Earnings and payouts are recorded separately from client payments.
noEarnings: Your completed shifts and earnings will appear here.
savedProgress: Each completed step is saved. You can return anytime.
payoutHelp: Payout setup will be coordinated by operations. Do not upload bank credentials here.
clientSetup: A few details, then you are ready
clientSetupCopy: Add your primary location so we can coordinate help nearby.
locationManualHelp: Check the address and coordinates. You can enter coordinates manually if location access is unavailable.
engagement: How long do you need help?
scheduleHelp: Times use your device timezone. Review every date before submitting.
quoteHelp: Final pricing is confirmed by operations before an offer.
noUpdates: Updates about your work will appear here.
NETWORK_ERROR: Could not connect. Your saved progress is safe. Check your connection and try again.
VALIDATION_ERROR: Check the highlighted information and try again.
EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED: This email already has an account. Try signing in.
PHONE_ALREADY_REGISTERED: This mobile number already has an account.
SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
EMAIL_UNAVAILABLE: Password reset email is not configured yet. Please contact support.
JOB_ALREADY_ASSIGNED: This offer is no longer available. Check your latest offers.
INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This action is no longer available. Refresh the page.
OUTSIDE_GEOFENCE: You are outside the work location. Move closer, retry, or request manual check-in.
LOCATION_INACCURATE: GPS accuracy is low. Move to an open area and retry.
LOCATION_STALE: Your location is out of date. Capture a new location.
CHECK_IN_WINDOW_CLOSED: Check-in is outside the allowed time. Contact operations for help.
WORKER_NOT_VERIFIED: Verification must be approved before starting work.
SHIFT_NOT_ACTIVE: This shift cannot be updated in its current state.
OUTSIDE_SERVICE_AREA: This location is outside the selected service area.
FORBIDDEN: Your account does not have access to this action.
ONBOARDING_INCOMPLETE: Complete the remaining profile steps first.
CONFLICT: This action was already recorded or conflicts with an existing record. Refresh and try again.
linkUnavailable: This page is not available yet. Please try again later.
